title: js2264/plexembler pipeline - params.input schema
description: The species (--input): one row per nanopore run of a species; the rows of a species are its runs. A relative path is read from the samplesheet's folder, so file paths are strings here and the pipeline checks that they exist (docs/usage.md). An unknown value is NA, or an empty cell.

species.errorMessage: A species' ID: a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens (no underscore: it starts the name of every contig of the species, <species>_<contig>)

pool.errorMessage: A pool's ID: a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens

ont.errorMessage: The species' nanopore reads: a FASTQ file (.fastq, .fq, gzipped or not), without spaces in its path

genome_size.errorMessage: The expected genome size, in bases, with an optional k, m or g (12m); NA when unknown

ploidy.errorMessage: The expected ploidy: a whole number, 1 or more; NA when unknown

n_chromosomes.errorMessage: The expected number of nuclear chromosomes: a whole number, 1 or more; NA when unknown

busco_lineage.errorMessage: A BUSCO lineage dataset, as `busco --list-datasets` names it; NA to let BUSCO choose

genetic_code.errorMessage: An NCBI translation table for the nuclear genes: 1, or 12 for the CUG-Ser clade, 26 for the CUG-Ala clade; NA when unknown

telomere_repeat.errorMessage: The telomeric repeat unit, in bases (TGTGGG); NA, or empty, to find it from the reads
